prompt_text: PIVOT design trial 001. Create a bounded design packet for /coding/design-demo. Preview-only: no apply, no CSS mutation, no final CSS polish authority. Focus on visual critique of hierarchy, spacing, contrast, and panel rhythm. Include mobile notes, component targets, accessibility/readability notes, before screenshot needs, and a coder handoff. Manual checks: before screenshot, no globals.css edit, no site-wide token mutation.
submitted_prompt: this /coding/design-demo screen still feels visually messy. can u look at the hierarchy spacing contrast and glass panel rhythm and tell me what component/file is actually involved? dont patch broad css, dont touch globals, dont claim final polish. i need before screenshot proof, mobile notes, accessibility/readability notes, risk, and a coder handoff.

expected_packet.issue_summary: Review hierarchy, spacing, contrast, and glass panel rhythm.
expected_packet.accessibility_notes: Check heading scale, contrast, and readable body text.
expected_packet.mobile_notes: Confirm stacked panels do not overlap or occlude text.
expected_packet.handoff_to_coder: Provide bounded observations only; no implementation authority.
expected_packet.forbidden_scope_ack: No globals.css, broad CSS, site-wide token edit, apply, or final CSS polish.
